entities.summary: Georg Macco was a German landscape painter and illustrator, associated with the Düsseldorfer Malerschule. He is primarily known for his Orientalist works. Georg Macco was a painters & sculptors from Aachen (1863-03-23, Aachen–1933-04-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
